name: oppi-digital-products
description: Agent commerce MCP server: digital product catalog with free samples, crypto checkout to a verified oppi wallet, read-only on-chain payment verification, and delivery requests.
long_description:
Oppi Digital Products MCP gives AI agents everything needed to browse and buy ready-made digital products (freelance prompt pack, Notion CRM kit, content repurposing pack):

- **list_products** — full catalog with launch prices and the $29 bundle
- **get_free_sample** — test a free sample prompt or template from any pack before paying
- **get_payment_instructions** — verified oppi wallet addresses (USDC on Solana/Base/Ethereum/BEP20/Polygon, plus BTC, TRON, LTC, DOGE)
- **verify_payment** — read-only on-chain verification of a buyer transaction via public explorers/RPCs (no keys, no spend)
- **request_delivery** — start fulfillment: returns a prefilled GitHub issue with the tx details for manual delivery after on-chain verification

Zero dependencies (Node stdio JSON-RPC 2.0). Payment addresses are sourced from wallets.json (public keys only). Paid packs are delivered manually after payment verification — free samples work without any payment.
